provenance.instrument: Zoning Ordinance of the City of Greensburg (Chapter 265 Zoning, Ord. No. 908 of 4-14-1971, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 GR1413, City of Greensburg, Westmoreland County (265-7 COURT: 'The Court of Commons Pleas of Westmoreland County'). Chapter 265 was adopted 4-14-1971 by Ord. No. 908. The definitions were last amended 4-14-2025 by Ord. No. 2175 and the R1 uses 6-9-2025 by Ord. No. 2176. New Laws lists Ord. No. 2187 (charter), 2188 and 2189 (debt) of 2026, none on zoning. Local news in 2025 reported a first full zoning update in about 30 years under way with Mackin Engineering. No adoption was found and New Laws shows none through 8-10-2026
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: 'Includes legislation through 03-09-2026.' New Laws: Ord. No. 2187 to 2189 of 2026, none on zoning
checks: The zoning chapter has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar use
In R1 land and structures may be used 'for the following uses only', the first being 'One-family dwelling' (265-12A). R2 adds 'Two-family dwelling' and 'Multiple-family dwelling' (265-17B, C)

'Not more than one (1) main structure or main use shall occupy any zoning lot or substandard lot of record, except where a unit group building or planned unit group development use has been approved' (265-52). A dwelling in a separate building, such as over a garage, may count as a second main structure. The code does not say so in words. Ask the zoning officer

'Lot area or lot width requirements shall not be held to prohibit the erection of a one-family dwelling or duplex on a substandard lot of record' (265-48I). A substandard lot of record is an R district lot held in separate ownership since the zoning origin date (265-7). Such a lot in R2 may hold a duplex even if it has less than 7,200 sq ft
Heights are measured to the mean height between eaves and ridge on a gabled, hipped or gambrel roof (265-7 'Structure, height of'). This applies to the 18 ft and 35 ft caps

A one-family dwelling is 'A building containing one dwelling unit only' and a two-family dwelling 'A building containing two dwelling units only' (265-7). A dwelling unit is 'As defined in the Uniform Construction Code'

Accessory structures are at most 18 ft tall in every district (265-43). Storage sheds stand in the rear yard, 2 ft from side and rear lines, at most 16 by 12 ft (265-48H(2)). A minor garage or carport may stand in a required side or rear yard 5 ft from a property line (265-48D)
A city zoning update was reported under way in 2025. Ask the Planning and Development office whether a new ordinance has been adopted

In the Downtown District overlay any construction, addition or exterior alteration needs a certificate of appropriateness from City Council (265-40.2, 265-40.3), and the district has no off-street parking minimum (265-40.8.1)
No section read bars a use variance. Variances are heard under MPC 910.2 (265-127D)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: City of Greensburg Planning and Development. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, mostly in print view. Searched the code (scope all) for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family apartment, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, relative, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, servants, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, accessory suite, farm dwelling, two-family and caregiver. Only two-family hits and 'living quarters' in the recreational vehicle definition came up. Read: 265-7 (definitions, in the chapter print view), 265-8 to 265-10, Article IV (R1, 265-11 to 265-15), 265-17 (R2), Articles VI to IX (C1, C2, M, S uses), 265-38 (R-T uses), Articles XA, XB, XC (Downtown, Gateway and Health Care overlays), 265-43, Article XII (265-45 to 265-48, the 265-47 table checked on screen), Article XIII, 265-65, 265-122, 265-127, Article XXII (PRD), 265-48I and 265-12B(2). Not read: 265-44, 265-56 to 265-64, Article XV, XVI (nonconformance), XVII, 265-118 to 265-121, 265-129 to 265-132, Article XX, XXI, XXIII to XXV, and the 1971 PRD standards document on file. 265-15D(1) speaks of 'a permitted accessory dwelling' when it limits home occupations in accessory structures, but no section read lists or defines one. The Historic District named in 265-8 was repealed 11-9-2020 by Ord. No. 2113 (editor's note to Article XC).

term.note: Searched the code for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family apartment, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, relative, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, servants, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, accessory suite, farm dwelling, two-family and caregiver. No ADU use. 265-15D(1) mentions 'a permitted accessory dwelling' in the home occupation rules only

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot. Each district permits 'the following uses only'. A unit inside a house in R2 or C2 would make it a two-family dwelling, which is listed there. A dwelling in a separate building may also count as a second main structure, which 265-52 does not allow on a lot. The code does not say so in words, and a use variance is still a path to ask for

path.note: A second unit is not a listed use. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances 'pursuant to provisions and criteria in 53 P.S. § 10910.2'. 265-4B calls variances 'minor concessions' for special physical conditions of a lot

value.name: Two-family dwelling (R2, C2)
value.conditions: 'A building containing two dwelling units only' (265-7). Lot area 3,600 sq ft per dwelling unit, so 7,200 sq ft for the two. A substandard lot of record may hold a duplex with less, as 'Lot area or lot width requirements shall not be held to prohibit the erection of a one-family dwelling or duplex on a substandard lot of record' (265-48I). In R2: 60 ft wide, front yard 10 ft, side yards 5 ft each, rear yard 20 ft, land coverage 40%, height 35 ft. Two parking spaces per dwelling where the lot takes access from a public street (265-65A(3)). Land and structures may be 'erected, altered, enlarged and maintained' for the listed uses (265-17)
value.note: A building type. Turning a one-family house into two units makes it a two-family dwelling

requires.condition: the lot has at least 7,200 sq ft, or it is a substandard lot of record, an R district lot held in separate ownership since the zoning origin date

value.name: Multiple-family dwelling (R2, C2)
value.conditions: 'A building or portion thereof containing three or more dwelling units only' (265-7). 2,500 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit (in R2). A row dwelling may not exceed six units in length in R2 (265-17C). Multifamily units are at least 450 sq ft (265-48K)

value.name: Dwelling in a mixed-use building (C2)
value.conditions: 'Any mixed-use facility that includes commercial and residential uses' is a permitted use in C2. Land coverage up to 100%
value.note: The host is a commercial building, not a house

value.name: Multifamily, mixed-use or live/work unit in the Gateway or Health Care overlay (R1, R2)
value.conditions: On lots in the overlay, 'New development of multifamily residential', 'Mixed-use development' and 'Live/work units' are 'permitted as of right' besides the R1 and R2 uses. Mixed-use development must combine 'residential use with retail, offices, and similar uses' (265-40.14B(1)), so a house with one plain added unit is not mixed-use. A live/work unit is a dwelling unit with up to 50% of it used for arts and crafts (265-7). In the Health Care overlay live/work units in preservation neighborhoods are allowed 'only with careful consideration' (265-40.21A(4)). Mixed-use residential units are above the ground floor, live/work units may be on any floor. Units created by rehabilitation of a house need one space each (two or fewer bedrooms) or two (three or more). The Gateway overlay covers lots fronting East and West Pittsburgh Street, East and West Otterman Street, Main Street and West Newton Street, and it 'shall not exist where it would overlap' the Downtown or Health Care districts (265-40.11). The Health Care overlay map (Exhibit E) is on file at the city
value.note: Multifamily means three or more units (265-7). Whether one added live/work unit in a house is allowed on its own is not stated

value.name: Planned unit group development (R districts, 5 acres or more)
value.conditions: A conditional use decided by City Council after a Planning Commission hearing. 'In any R District in a development of five acres or more, dwellings of any type shall be permitted', at the district density on net site area, with 25% common open space

historic_bypass.note: No historic ADU path found. The Historic District was repealed in 2020

districts_read_no_listing.note: C1 permits shops and services. Its only housing uses are student homes (265-21B(15)), short-term rentals (265-21B(12)) and, by special exception, a one-family dwelling without the required parking space (265-21B(11)(b)). No second unit on a house lot. M is industrial and 'Residential ... uses are considered not compatible and are prohibited' (265-28). S permits institutions, institutional living units and a student home (265-33C). R-T permits townhouses. R3 is the planned residential development district. It allows 'single-family dwellings, semidetached and duplex dwellings, townhouses' only inside a development approved by City Council under Article XXII (265-173)

types_allowed.note: No ADU use. A unit inside the house is possible only as a two-family dwelling in R2 or C2 (see alternatives)

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'Accessory structure' 18 ft in R1, R2, C1, C2, M and S. Measured to the mean height between eaves and ridge on a gabled, hipped or gambrel roof (265-7)

value.where: Storage sheds: in the required rear yard, at least 2 ft from side and rear lines, at most 16 by 12 ft, with a building permit
A minor garage or carport may stand partly or entirely in a required side or rear yard, at least 5 ft from a property line or open right-of-way
A grounds maintenance structure: one per tract, at most 144 sq ft and 12 ft high, in the rear yard, at least 2 ft from the lines

spaces_required.note: No ADU use. A single-family detached dwelling needs 2.0 spaces (2.5 from a private street or common drive). A two-family dwelling needs 2.0 per dwelling

min_lot_sqft.note: One-family dwelling, per dwelling unit. 60 ft wide (80 ft on a corner lot). A substandard lot of record may hold a one-family dwelling or duplex with less (265-48I)

setback_front_ft.note: Reduced to the average block setback where that is less (265-48A)

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard width, each of 2' for a one-family dwelling

principal_max_height_ft.note: One-family dwelling. Measured to the mean height between eaves and ridge on a gabled, hipped or gambrel roof (265-7)

max_building_coverage.note: 'Land coverage' is the share of a zoning lot 'which may be occupied by structures, parking area and loading space, but not including access driveways or area occupied by structures or uses permitted in required yards' (265-7). Parking and loading areas count, so the share for buildings alone may be lower. A garage or carport allowed in a required yard under 265-48D does not count

min_lot_sqft.note: One-family dwelling, per dwelling unit. 60 ft wide (80 ft on a corner lot). A substandard lot of record may hold a one-family dwelling or duplex with less (265-48I)

setback_front_ft.note: Reduced to the average block setback where that is less (265-48A)

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard width, each of 2' for a one-family dwelling

principal_max_height_ft.note: One-family dwelling. Measured to the mean height between eaves and ridge on a gabled, hipped or gambrel roof (265-7)

max_building_coverage.note: 'Land coverage' is the share of a zoning lot 'which may be occupied by structures, parking area and loading space, but not including access driveways or area occupied by structures or uses permitted in required yards' (265-7). Parking and loading areas count, so the share for buildings alone may be lower. A garage or carport allowed in a required yard under 265-48D does not count

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Set for a two-family dwelling. A substandard lot of record, an R district lot held in separate ownership since the zoning origin date, may hold a duplex with less (265-48I)

max_building_coverage.note: 'Land coverage' is the share of a zoning lot 'which may be occupied by structures, parking area and loading space, but not including access driveways or area occupied by structures or uses permitted in required yards' (265-7). Parking and loading areas count, so the share for buildings alone may be lower. A garage or carport allowed in a required yard under 265-48D does not count

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Two-family dwelling, per dwelling unit. The table sets no one-family lot area, side yard or height for C2. The lot of record relief in 265-48I speaks of R district lots
